## Working policy

- Inspect only files relevant to this task.
- Search symbols and references before opening large files.
- Distinguish observed facts, inferences, assumptions and unknowns.
- State the smallest planned change before editing.
- Preserve existing behaviour unless the task requires a change.
- Add or update tests for changed behaviour.
- Check coverage impact.
- Avoid rereading unchanged files and avoid reproducing full files.
- Stop and report blockers instead of guessing.

## Completion report

- Summary.
- Files changed.
- Tests and checks run.
- Coverage impact.
- Risks and assumptions.
- Remaining work.
